description:
Create a stepped shaft in FreeCAD using a revolution operation.

1. Create a new document.
2. Create a sketch on the XZ plane.
3. Draw a closed profile with these coordinates (mm):
   (0,0) to (15,0) to (15,25) to (8,25) to (8,60) to (0,60) back to (0,0)
   (This represents a half-profile of the shaft).
4. Use the Revolution tool to revolve this profile 360° around the vertical Z axis.
5. Save the file to '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/stepped_shaft.FCStd'.

The final part should have a lower section (30mm diameter, 25mm height) and an upper section (16mm diameter, 35mm height).
